why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither is broken. Item 1: the verifier's Check 3 requires every exported function to have its own README section. It names slugify directly: "check slugify and padLeft in particular" and "FAIL: any exported function, slugify included, has no README section." A README with only a padLeft section would fail. Item 2: no PASS or FAIL condition is stricter than its line. Check 1 only tests what its line covers: the space default, padding on the left and the length reaching width. Check 2 only tests that s comes back unchanged. Check 3 asks for "a markdown heading that names the function," which is just what a section is, with no required layout or order. Check 4 asks for exit status 0. The multi-character fill and the tests are only in the advisory list, marked as not affecting PASS or FAIL. Layout and placement guidance ("above ## Tests") appears only in the builder brief, not as a check.
